description: This is a Java test class for the DiagnosisServiceImpl in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations, retrieval methods, attribute handling, and special cases for Diagnosis entities, using JUnit 5 and OpenMRS API.

classes.name: DiagnosisServiceImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of DiagnosisServiceImpl in OpenMRS, focusing on diagnoses and their attributes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test dependencies and loads test datasets before each test.

methods.name: saveDiagnosis_shouldSaveNewDiagnosis
methods.description: Tests saving a new Diagnosis object along with its attributes.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid_shouldFindDiagnosisGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a Diagnosis by UUID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisById_shouldFindDiagnosifGivenId
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a Diagnosis by ID.

methods.name: getPrimaryDiagnoses_shouldGetPrimaryDiagnoses
methods.description: Tests fetching primary diagnoses for an encounter.

methods.name: getDiagnoses_shouldGetDiagnosesOfPatientWithDate
methods.description: Verifies retrieving diagnoses for a patient on a specific date.

methods.name: getDiagnoses_shouldGetDiagnosesOfPatientWithDifferentDate
methods.description: Fetches diagnoses for a patient on a different date.

methods.name: getDiagnoses_shouldGetDiagnosesOfPatientWithoutDate
methods.description: Fetches all diagnoses for a patient without date filtering.

methods.name: getUniqueDiagnoses_shouldGetUniqueDiagnosesOfPatient
methods.description: Retrieves unique diagnoses for a patient.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter_shouldGetDiagnosesForEncounter
methods.description: Fetches diagnoses associated with an encounter with specific filters.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit_shouldGetDiagnosesForVisit
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a visit.

methods.name: voidDiagnosis_shouldVoidDiagnosisSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests voiding a diagnosis and setting reason, user, and timestamp.

methods.name: unvoidDiagnosis_shouldUnvoidDiagnosisSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests unvoiding a previously voided diagnosis.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosis_shouldPurgeDiagnosis
methods.description: Tests complete deletion of a diagnosis.

methods.name: getAllDiagnosisAttributeTypes_shouldReturnAllDiagnosisAttributeTypesIncludingRetiredOnes
methods.description: Retrieves all diagnosis attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById_shouldReturnTheDiagnosisAttributeTypeUsingTheProvidedId
methods.description: Fetches a diagnosis attribute type by ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeType_shouldReturnNullIfNoDiagnosisAttributeTypeExistsWithTheProvidedId
methods.description: Verifies null response when diagnosis attribute type by ID does not exist.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldReturnTheDiagnosisAttributeTypeWithTheProvidedUuid
methods.description: Fetches diagnosis attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoDiagnosisAttributeTypeExistsWithTheProvidedUuid
methods.description: Verifies null response when uuid does not correspond to any attribute type.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosisAttributeType_shouldCompletelyRemoveTheDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Removes a diagnosis attribute type permanently.

methods.name: retireDiagnosisAttributeType_shouldRetireADiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Marks an attribute type as retired with a reason.

methods.name: unretireDiagnosisAttributeType_shouldUnretireARetiredDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Reverses the retired status of an attribute type.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType_shouldSaveTheProvidedDiagnosisAttributeTypeToTheDatabase
methods.description: Creates and saves a new diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType_shouldEditTheExistingDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute type.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid_shouldGetTheDiagnosisAttributeWithTheProvidedUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute by UUID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoDiagnosisAttributeHasTheProvidedUuid
methods.description: Verifies null response for non-existing attribute UUID.

methods.name: saveDiagnosis_shouldSaveTheDiagnosisWithTheProvidedAttributes
methods.description: Saves a diagnosis including associated attributes.

methods.name: saveDiagnosis_shouldEditTheExistingDiagnosisRemovingTheAssociatedAttributesWhenRequired
methods.description: Updates a diagnosis by removing an attribute and saving changes.
